title: Theoretically Sound Item Similarity Measures for Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.34402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantifying the similarity between items is fundamental to neighborhood-based collaborative filtering, yet many commonly used similarity measures are heuristics that lack theoretical justification. The use of heuristics forces practitioners to rely on empirical trial-and-error, offering little insight into why certain measures outperform others or how they might be improved. In this paper, we present a principled approach for designing item similarity measures grounded in probabilistic modeling and parameter estimation.   By adopting this formal perspective, we derive two previously overlooked similarity measures based on the Bernoulli and multinomial distributions. translated_title: 面向推荐系统的理论可靠的物品相似度度量
translated_abstract: 量化物品之间的相似度是基于邻域的协同过滤的基础，然而许多常用的相似度度量都是缺乏理论依据的启发式方法。使用启发式方法迫使从业者依赖经验性的试错，既无法深入洞察为什么某些度量方法优于其他方法，也无法了解如何改进它们。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于概率建模和参数估计的、有原则的物品相似度度量设计方法。通过采用这一形式化视角，我们推导出了两种此前被忽视的、基于伯努利分布和多项式分布的相似度度量。通过广泛的消融研究，我们强调了偏差、概率平滑、正确处理未知量以及选择合适概率分布的关键作用。最后，我们表明常用的余弦相似度可以被解释为该框架下的一个求解结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于概率建模与参数估计的原则性方法来设计物品相似度度量，推导出基于伯努利分布和多项式分布的两种新度量，并证明常用的余弦相似度也可在此理论框架下得到解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a principled approach for designing item similarity measures grounded in probabilistic modeling and parameter estimation, derives two previously overlooked measures based on Bernoulli and multinomial distributions, and shows that the commonly used cosine similarity can be interpreted within this theoretical framework.
